title: Automated micro-fencing: granular prompt-set gates for staged model flips
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Introduce an automated 'micro-fencing' system that applies fine-grained eval-prompt gating during staged model flips (canary, A/B, shadow). Instead of a single monolithic golden-set gate for all traffic, micro-fencing maintains per-customer and per-route small golden subsets and enforces probabilistic quarantine thresholds. Goals: 1) detect localized regressions that would be diluted by global aggregates, 2) enable earlier safe rollouts by isolating suspect segments, and 3) minimize blast radius via automatic quarantine/rollback of specific customer segments or routes. The feature should integrate with the existing rollout orchestrator, scorecard pipeline, and alerting.
acceptance_criteria: Micro-fencing can be enabled per-customer and per-route via rollout policy config
System computes composite quality score (semantic + task metrics) for each micro-fence every minute
If micro-fence score degrades beyond configurable threshold for X minutes, traffic for that micro-fence is quarantined and weight shifted back to baseline model automatically
Shadow traffic path can exercise micro-fences without impacting live weight; shadow alerts surface to QA dashboard
End-to-end latency impact under 1% for requests when micro-fencing is enabled on typical workloads
Docs and console UI controls added: enable/disable, thresholds, retention for golden-sets
implementation_notes: Extend scorecard pipeline to emit per-customer composite score vector with timestamp and fingerprint hash
Store micro-fence golden subsets in S3 partitioned by customer and route; implement compact delta upload to minimize sync
New 'micro-fence' policy object in rollout config: fields = {enabled, threshold, window_mins, quarantine_action, min_samples, probabilistic_sampling_rate}
Leverage existing KV cache to reduce repeated eval tokenization cost for golden prompts
Use asynchronous lateral actor to apply quarantine decisions so main-serving path remains non-blocking
Add metrics: microfence.score, microfence.delta_pct, microfence.quarantines, microfence.affected_rps
tests: Unit: score aggregation and threshold logic (edge cases: zero-coverage, high-variance)
Integration: staged canary with 5 customers and synthetic golden drift injected — verify quarantines trigger for only affected customers
Load: run with 1k micro-fences enabled to measure latency and pipeline throughput
Chaos: simulate partial loss of golden-set storage and ensure graceful degradation (fail-open vs fail-closed policy test)
E2E: verify rollback/weight-shift actions in canary UI and confirm telemetry reflects action
comments: 2026-03-01 Sofia Martinez: Initial scope and design doc posted. Decided to prioritize per-customer gates over global-only gates based on recent regression incident analysis.

2026-03-02 Ethan Kim: Prototype of micro-fence policy object implemented in orchestrator branch; opening PR for initial review (see design_links). Needs input from infra on storage layout for golden subsets.

2026-03-03 Priya Rao (SRE): Storage proposal reviewed — prefer S3 with lifecycle and multi-part upload for large customer sets. Concern: eventual consistency windows may affect immediate quarantine; suggested optimistic local cache with TTL.
2026-03-04 Maya Liu (PM): Requested UI wireframes for per-customer threshold controls and an option to 'quarantine only' vs 'rollback full route'. Added as follow-up scope if time permits.

2026-03-05 Ethan Kim: Ran integration test with synthetic drift for 3 customers. Quarantine logic triggered correctly for two customers, third showed false-positive due to very low sample count. Adding min_samples gate and probabilistic sampling to reduce noise.
